conventions: Pure, DB-free, clock-free rules first; controllers only wire them.
An unknown is never a zero; roll-ups return counts and name no one; a view that cannot answer says so.
What must not be stored gets no column; what must not be disclosed gets no endpoint.
A new table holding personal data joins the subject-access export, the erasure statements and (if soft-deleting) the retention sweep list.
Internal links in the UI use `l("/path")` so the locale prefix is kept; every new UI string goes in every `-001` locale and `pnpm cms-config` is rerun.
Podman, not Docker; PostgreSQL, not SQLite.
